name: Glenn Adult Program (Glenn County Office of Education)
description: Adult basic education, high school diploma completion, GED prep, ESL & citizenship classes, career training (Medical Assistant, Teacher Assistant, Receptionist), computer literacy, CPR, and paraprofessional certification preparation.

name: Butte-Glenn Adult Education Consortium (Oroville serves Glenn)
description: Supports academic, literacy, and career-readiness training programs across Glenn and Butte Counties.

name: Glenn County Behavioral Health Services
description: Clinical assessments, outpatient counseling, medication support, case management, crisis intervention, and drop-in peer support at Harmony House.
address: 1187 East South Street, Orland, CA 95963 and 242 N Villa Avenue, Willows, CA 95988

name: Glenn County Public Health Services
description: Free pregnancy testing, seasonal flu clinics, TB skin tests ($25), service coordination, immunizations, family and oral health programs.

name: Glenn County Behavioral Health – Housing & Homeless Support
description: The Continuum of Care (CoC) is a community plan to organize and deliver housing and services to meet the specific needs of people who are homeless as they move to stable housing and maximum self-sufficiency. It includes action steps to end homelessness and prevent a return to homelessness. Glenn County Housing and Weatherization Unit
address: (Main offices) 1187 East South Street, Orland, CA 95963 and 242 N Villa Avenue, Willows, CA 95988

name: Glenn County Health & Human Services Agency (HHSA)
description: Medi-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKs, General Assistance, Child and Adult Protective Services, IHSS, veteran services.
address: Several locations please refer to website below.

name: Glenn County Substance Use Disorder Services (SUDS)
description: Assessment, treatment planning, individual/group counseling, family support, crisis intervention.

name: Glenn County Community Action Department Employment Services

description: Resume prep, career advice, occupational exploration, vocational training referrals, Basic Skills Assessment, and EDD connections.

name: North Valley Community Food Bank
